description: 擅长战斗的军团士兵。随身一块军功牌：打赢一场记一笔，牌越亮、牌边的武器越狠。生命 {max_hp}、耐力 {max_stamina}、耐力回得最快。

descriptions.en: A legion soldier who is good at fighting. He carries a phalera: every win earns Honor, and the brighter it gets, the harder the weapons around it hit. Health {max_hp}, Stamina {max_stamina} and the fastest Stamina regeneration.

skills.description: 耐力低于两成时，立即恢复 {change_resource_amount} 点耐力（每场一次）。

descriptions.en: When your Stamina drops below a fifth, restore {change_resource_amount} Stamina at once (once per battle).
